exact_statement: For the canonical quadratic bent splice X009 on m+1 physical bits, every even m>=4 has its relevant-coordinate minima B_i/I_i and Delta_iH/I_i attained exactly by data coordinates, with closed forms (7) in REPORT.md, sharp family suprema 2 and 4 respectively. For the canonical B05 activation of that splice with even k>=4 and r=2k controls, the B_i/I_i minimum is data at k=4 and control at k>=6, while the Delta_iH/I_i minimum is data at k=4,6,8,10,12 and control at every even k>=14. Formula (19) gives both exact minima. Their limits are 2 and 4; a uniformly bounded decrement coordinate exists with ratio less than 4+41/512. The selector never minimizes either ratio.

exact_statement: For B05 quadratic bent point surgery with even k>=4 and r>=2k controls, min_i B_i/Inf_i is the data-coordinate ratio in REPORT.md (B05-X) at k=4 and psi(2^(-r)(1-2^(-k/2)+2^(-k))) at k>=6. Its sharp uniform supremum is psi(57/262144)<2+7/1024. For the A062 k-control activation of a balancing sign times M=2^(k-1) quadratic bent factors, the balancing-sign coordinate uniquely minimizes the ratio, which equals (1-q)Phi(1,v)+Phi((1-q)^2,q^2 v)/q with q=2^(-k),v=4^(-M). Its sharp uniform supremum is (5/4)log2(5)-2<1 and its limit is zero.
